name: Nai-Wen Chi
interests: Biomaterials and drug delivery for tissue repair; material-cell interactions; targeted delivery and functional evaluation of genetic medicines.

education.title: M.S., Biomedical Engineering
education.detail: GPA: 4.05/4.30. Thesis research: nitric-oxide-releasing microparticles for osteoporosis therapy.

research.title: R&D and Regulatory Scientist
bullets: Prepared and submitted briefing materials with the project team for an FDA INTERACT meeting completed June 30, 2026, supporting early development of genetic medicines.
Analyzed CMC and nonclinical evidence gaps against FDA guidance; organized technical-document requirements and literature support for development planning.
Reconciled FDA and internal meeting minutes and prepared follow-up response drafts and question summaries for cross-functional review.

research.title: Research Assistant
research.org: Academia Sinica, Taiwan | Dr. Yu-Jung Lin
bullets: Prepared polymer conjugates, ligand-modified nanoparticles, and liposomes; compared formulation and purification conditions for drug-delivery research.
Used particle-size and zeta-potential measurements and HPLC to assess formulation properties, drug loading, and release; prepared alginate hydrogels and evaluated gelation time.

research.title: R&D Engineer
bullets: Developed tyramine-alginate hydrogel systems for cartilage adhesion and regeneration; co-authored the 2022 cartilage-repair paper listed on page 2.
Contributed to scaffold fabrication and mechanical testing for a cartilage-repair implant; supported mini-pig studies and surgical usability evaluation.
Provided equipment setup and instrument sterilization coordination during human clinical surgical cases; contributed to regulatory documentation and surgical instrument design.

research.title: R&D Engineer
bullets: Supported R&D projects and clinical trials for Class III medical devices.

research.title: Master's Research | Nitric Oxide Delivery for Osteoporosis
bullets: Designed phase-change microparticles for nitric oxide (NO) delivery; performed in vitro assays and in vivo studies using an ovariectomized rat model of osteoporosis.
Co-authored the 2018 Advanced Materials paper; named co-inventor on a temperature-responsive delivery composition patent family.

publications.title: Calcium peroxide aids tyramine-alginate gel to crosslink with tyrosinase for efficient cartilage repair.

publications.authors: Lin YJ, Chen CC, Chi NW, Nguyen T, Lu HY, Nguyen D, Lai PL, Sung HW.
publications.title: In Situ Self-Assembling Micellar Depots that Can Actively Trap and Passively Release NO with Long-Lasting Activity to Reverse Osteoporosis.

regulatory.title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
bullets: Led TFDA medical-device license applications and amendments; prepared EU IVDR and U.S. FDA IVD submission documentation and supported ISO 13485 and TFDA QMS audits.

regulatory.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist / Project Manager
bullets: Managed TFDA Class I-III device applications; led a Class II application and coordinated supporting preclinical evidence. Supported design controls, ISO 13485 and TFDA QMS audits, and international documentation including EU MDR requirements.

skills: Polymer conjugation and ligand modification; nanoparticle and liposome preparation; scaffold and alginate-hydrogel fabrication.
DLS and zeta potential; HPLC drug-loading analysis; gelation-time and mechanical testing; sample preparation for NMR and GPC.
In vitro assays; ovariectomized rat osteoporosis studies; support for mini-pig studies. WST-1, ALP activity, Alizarin Red S, H&E histology, serum ALP and osteocalcin.
additional: Chief Executive Officer & Project Manager, Wen Fu AI Co., Taiwan (Jul 2023 - Mar 2024). Founded a small technology venture; managed online-course and AI-assisted website projects, including scope, schedules, and client communication.
Graduate study preparation, Taiwan (Mar 2024 - Mar 2025). Prepared doctoral applications and completed English proficiency testing.
